mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS name, m.email AS email, m.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, cp.relation_type AS relationType, CASE WHEN cp.relation_type IN ('MOTHER', 'FATHER') THEN 'PARENT' WHEN cp.relation_type = 'GUARDIAN' THEN 'GUARDIAN' END AS familyRole, cp.created_at AS linkedAt FROM child_parent cp INNER JOIN member m ON cp.member_id = m.member_id INNER JOIN child c ON cp.child_id = c.child_id WHERE cp.child_id = #{childId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cp.relation_type IN ('MOTHER', 'FATHER', 'GUARDIAN') ORDER BY cp.created_at ASC

SELECT c.child_id AS childId, CASE WHEN c.member_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS linked, m.member_id AS childMemberId, m.name AS childMemberName, m.email AS childMemberEmail, m.profile_image_url AS childMemberProfileImageUrl, m.status AS childMemberStatus, CASE WHEN c.member_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE c.updated_at END AS linkedAt FROM child c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.child_id = #{childId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT child_id FROM child WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE family_invitation SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE invitee_type = #{inviteeType} AND ( (#{inviteeType} = 'PARENT' AND inviter_member_id = #{inviterMemberId}) OR (#{inviteeType} = 'CHILD' AND child_id = #{childId}) ) AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= #{now}

SELECT fi.family_invitation_id AS familyInvitationId, c.name AS childName, inviter.name AS inviterName, fi.invitee_type AS inviteeType, fi.status AS status, fi.expires_at AS expiresAt FROM family_invitation fi INNER JOIN child c ON fi.child_id = c.child_id INNER JOIN member inviter ON fi.inviter_member_id = inviter.member_id WHERE fi.invite_token_hash = #{inviteTokenHash}
